from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        debate = operator.Debate(worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=4, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.WORKER_TTT_DEBATE_LEGALIST, prompt_custom.WORKER_TTT_DEBATE_WINFIRST, prompt_custom.WORKER_TTT_DEBATE_BLOCKFIRST, prompt_custom.WORKER_TTT_DEBATE_TIEBREAK], aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.AGG_TTT_DEBATE_PICK_BEST, n_rounds=2)
        draft = await debate(problem)
        star = operator.Star(worker_llm=self.aggregator_llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.WORKER_TTT_FINAL_REPAIR_A, prompt_custom.WORKER_TTT_FINAL_REPAIR_B, prompt_custom.WORKER_TTT_FINAL_REPAIR_C], aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.AGG_TTT_FINAL_SELECT)
        solution = await star(f"Problem:\n{problem}\n\nDraft:\n{draft['response']}")
        return solution["response"], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }
